title: wkchat session routing guard -- nested calls stay session-aware
desc: wkchat starts an interactive chat session. When the current or parent process already carries a chat session marker, descendant wkappbot calls stay in session-aware routing mode so nested launches do not re-enter interactive chat.
steps: Chat sessions set and inherit WKAPPBOT_CHAT_SESSION=1
Use wkappbot chat for interactive REPL only; nested commands inside the session must be treated as single-shot calls
If a child launch needs interactive chat behavior, clear the session marker in the parent shell before starting it
Verify the live behavior with wkappbot chat --help and wkappbot skill read wkchat-session-routing-guard
Keep the outer chat guard in the launcher; nested chat sessions still inherit WKAPPBOT_CHAT_SESSION=1 for child routing
When the session guard is active, Launcher keeps chat on the interactive stdio path and skips Eye routing
